items.headline: Dieffenbach returns from injury scare, No. 4 UCLA remains unbeaten with 22-14 victory over Illinois
items.description: — UCLA received a major scare when quarterback Ty Dieffenbach went to the locker room with a left elbow injury in the second quarter of Friday’s game.
